from datetime import datetime

# login to file_system
pw=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
access_token=apis.file_system.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']

base_dir='~/photographs/vacations/'
files=apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path=base_dir, access_token=access_token, entry_type='files', recursive=False)

current_year=datetime.now().year

moved=[]
for fp in files:
    meta=apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=fp, access_token=access_token)
    dt=datetime.fromisoformat(meta.get('created_at'))
    if dt.year==current_year and dt.month==1:
        dest='Athens'
    elif dt.year==current_year and dt.month==4:
        dest='Seoul'
    else:
        dest='Paris'
    fname=fp.split('/')[-1]
    dest_path=f"{base_dir}{dest}/{fname}"
    resp=apis.file_system.move_file(source_file_path=fp, destination_file_path=dest_path, access_token=access_token, overwrite=False, retain_dates=True)
    moved.append((fname, fp, resp.get('destination_file_path', dest_path), dest, dt.isoformat()))

print('moved_count:', len(moved))
# print grouped by destination
from collections import defaultdict
by_dest=defaultdict(list)
for fname, src, dst, dest, created_at in moved:
    by_dest[dest].append((fname, src, dst, created_at))
for dest in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']:
    print(dest, 'count', len(by_dest[dest]))
    for item in by_dest[dest]:
        print(' ', item[0], 'created_at', item[3], '->', item[2])
